conbody.p: A project can have a cover photo, shown across the top of its Overview and on the project in All projects. Before there is one, a slim box at the top of the page offers Add a cover photo; choose a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image. A large photo is scaled down in your browser before it is saved, and a file over 5 MB is refused. Once there is a cover, Change cover in its corner replaces it and Remove takes it away. Anyone who can see the project sees its cover; changing it takes an editor.
